The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-second season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S22|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends]], in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==Partial collections== Three ''Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends'' Collections released by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}} in 2020 and 2021, containing the whole season between them. ===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends - The Last Grand Trial=== [[File:Pokémon the Series Sun & Moon Ultra Legends The Last Grand Trial.jpg|thumb|200px|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends - The Last Grand Trial]] Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends - The Last Grand Trial was released on September 8, 2020 by VIZ Media and distributed through Warner Home Video. It contains two discs, with 18 episodes across them combined. Optional English closed captioning is included. Clean versions of the [[The Challenge of Life|opening and ending themes]] are included as a special feature. ====Contents==== {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
